name: hitalk-next
description: 可自托管的轻量评论系统
author: ihoey <mail@ihoey.com> (https://blog.ihoey.com/)

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:setup && concurrently --kill-others --names worker,web "pnpm run dev:server" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @hitalk/server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @hitalk/sdk run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.dev.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:coverage
scripts.check:ci: pnpm run check && pnpm run test:worker && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:web
scripts.deploy: pnpm run check:ci && pnpm run deploy:server && pnpm run deploy:web
scripts.deploy:server: pnpm run db:migrate:remote && pnpm --filter @hitalk/server run deploy
scripts.db:seed: pnpm run dev:setup && pnpm --filter @hitalk/server run db:seed
